description: Quick Drought Response Index (QuickDRI) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Drought Mitigation Center; University of Nebraska-Lincoln | Center for Advanced Land Management Information Technologies; USGS, United States Geological Survey. Clear maps on this site can help identify the potential for rapid-onset, “flash drought” events. This index is a short-term indicator of dryness, calculated through the analysis of satellite- and model-based observations of conditions that influence drought. It provides a snapshot of anomalously dry or wet conditions over the past four weeks. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
